title: Out of scope
description:
This program should add the numbers 1 to 5 and print `15`. It does not compile, because `total` is defined inside the loop's braces and so does not exist on the line that prints it. (It would also be reset to zero every time round.)

Move the definition to the right place.
hints: A variable lives from its definition to the closing brace of the block it is in. `total` must be defined in a block that contains both the loop and the print statement.
